newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MATHOMO BUYS ALSAFE FOR 12.5 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: MATHOMO BUYS ALSAFE FOR 12.5 MLN RAND.

text.p: Mathomo Group Ltd said on Thursday it had acquired the entire share capital of and claims by way of loan account against Alsafe for a consideration of 12.5 million rand.
Alsafe is a manufacturer and distributor of protective clothing, safety equipment and related products.
The 12.5 million rand purchase consideration includes goodwill of 7.8 million rand.
One million rand of the purchase consideration is payable by the issue of 434,782 Mathomo ordinary shares at an issue price of 2.30 rand per share, the remaining 11.55 million rand in cash.
